summary: Claude Opus 5.5 creates a 3D animated scene of a legless bull running and bouncing on a dual-sphere suspension drivetrain across hurdles at sunset.

post.originalText:
OPUS 5.5 JUST REPLACED LEGS WITH BALL DRIVE.

I told it to make a bull that runs.

It removed the legs.

It installed two balls and called it a drivetrain.

Zero legs, two balls, full suspension.

Meet Bullistic, the first bull running on Ball Drive.

He pogo-sticks across a field at sunset, clears a fence in slow motion and lands like a pancake.

Then he bounces away like nothing happened.

Robotics labs spent 30 years teaching machines to walk.

This bull skipped legs entirely.
